modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On February 12, 1990: Carmen Lawrence becomes the first female Premier in Australian history when she becomes Premier of Western Australia.
On February 12, 1947: The largest observed iron meteorite until that time creates an impact crater in Sikhote-Alin, in the Soviet Union.
On February 12, 1404: The Italian professor Galeazzo di Santa Sofia performs the first post-mortem autopsy for the purposes of teaching and demonstration at the Heiligen–Geist Spital in Vienna.
February 12 is observed as Lincoln's Birthday (United States).
